attchmntText: Infosys Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Change in Corporate office address of the Company s Registrar and Share Transfer Agent'.
voiceSummary: Infosys Limited has received intimation from its Registrar and Share Transfer Agent, KFin Technologies Limited, regarding a change in the corporate office address effective December 1, 2026. The new address is 6, 23, 24, 25th Floor, South Tower, Rajapushpa West Avenue, Survey No. 115, Kokapet, Serilingampally Mandal, District Ranga Reddy, Hyderabad, Telangana 500075. The contact telephone number is 1800 309 4001 and the email address is einward.ris@kfintech.com. The company requests the exchange to update its records accordingly. This information will also be hosted on the company website at www.infosys.com. The notice was issued by A.G.S. Manikantha, Company Secretary, with membership number A21918, on November 18, 2026.

attchmntText: Infosys Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI LODR Regulations'.
voiceSummary: Infosys Limited’s wholly owned subsidiary, Infosys Singapore Pte. Ltd., will enter into a joint venture agreement with NTT DOCOMO, INC. Infosys is investing JPY 1.59bn to acquire a 10.1% stake in NTT Docomo Playspace, Inc. This joint venture is anchored by NTT Docomo and focuses on creating a virtual economic ecosystem in the metaverse in Japan. Infosys will serve as a minority investor and strategic technology and AI partner. As a minority shareholder, Infosys holds the right to nominate one director to the Board of the joint venture company. The transaction does not fall within related party transactions. The parties have no relationship with the promoter or promoter group. This intimation is filed under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Infosys Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Infosys Positioned as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant  for Public Cloud Optimization and Transformation Services for the Fourth Consecutive Year'.
voiceSummary: Infosys Limited announced on November 17, 2026, that it has been positioned as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Public Cloud Optimization and Transformation Services. This marks the fourth consecutive year the company has received this recognition. The announcement highlights Infosys' AI-first approach and its use of Infosys Cobalt and Infosys Topaz to help enterprises modernize hybrid multi-cloud environments. The press release was filed with the BSE, NSE, and NYSE. The information is also available on the company website at www.infosys.com. The filing was signed by Company Secretary A.G.S. Manikantha.

attchmntText: Infosys Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Six Promising Researchers Win the Infosys Prize 2026 Awarded by the Infosys Science Foundation'.
voiceSummary: Infosys Limited issued a press release on November 12, 2026, announcing that the Infosys Science Foundation awarded the Infosys Prize 2026 to six researchers. The laureates are Karthik Sastry in Economics, Swarun Kumar in Engineering and Computer Science, Gautam Bhatia in Humanities and Social Sciences, Isha Jain in Life Sciences, Riddhipratim Basu in Mathematical Sciences, and Manoj Kumar Joshi in Physical Sciences. Each winner receives a gold medal, a citation, and a prize purse of USD 100,000. The prize honors researchers under the age of 40. The winners were selected by an international panel of jurors and announced by the trustees of the Infosys Science Foundation. The information is hosted on the company website at www.infosys.com.
